result.title: The Certification Exponent: Instance-Optimal Sequential Certification of Policy Improvement from History Dependent Logs
result.comment: 62 pages, 8 figures. Submitted to the Journal of Machine Learning Research
result.summary: Before a new policy replaces a deployed one, we often want a certificate, computed from logged episodes, that it is better. We ask how many episodes such a certificate needs when the logging policy is known but history-dependent, and the error probability must stay below $δ$ in every environment consistent with the logs. The answer is an exponent $K^\star$: the smallest KL divergence from the logged law to a law with the same logged action probabilities under which the target does not improve. No sound certifier stops in fewer than $\log(1/δ)/K^\star$ expected episodes, at any $δ$, and whenever $0<K^\star<\infty$ a plug-in Kelly certifier attains this rate to first order as $δ\to0$. Coverage, computed by one backward induction, decides whether certification is impossible ($K^\star=0$), possible at a finite rate, or possible in a constant number of episodes ($K^\star=\infty$). By convex duality, the optimal certificate bets on the importance-weighted advantage and also places fair bets on the logged actions, so doubly robust control variates act as hedges rather than estimators. As a consequence, no choice of off-policy estimator changes $K^\star$, a coverage ceiling explains the curse of memory, and structural assumptions can be priced in exponent units. A cushion certifier extends the approach to trees too large to enumerate. In experiments the plug-in's median stopping time is 1.13-1.43x the lower bound on memory tasks, 1.13-1.51x on Tiger ($H\le5$) and 1.17-1.64x on random trees. The best scalar betting baselines need up to 2.65x (memory) and 4.1x (Tiger) the plug-in's episodes; only on a few shallow random trees is a doubly robust bet faster, by at most 18%.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究在日志策略已知但依赖历史时，从已记录 episode 中为「新策略更好」出具证明所需的最少样本量：给出实例最优的 KL 证书指数 K*、下界 log(1/δ)/K*、可达该速率的 plug-in Kelly 证书机制，并用覆盖度判定不可证明、有限速率或常数步三种情形，在 memory、Tiger 与随机树上实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「证据累积—停止」的信息论刻画（KL 下界、覆盖率决定的停止可行性、重要性加权下的估计器不变性）可能为 LVR 中 STOP 决策的收益/成本核算与「视觉证据是否充分」提供形式化线索，可供核查；但对象是策略认证与日志数据，与视觉 latent 无直接联系，迁移属推测。
